# Help leaves the TOC and tab cards alone (#270)

Open this file with another tab beside it, show the contents panel (Tab),
press **?** for Help, close it again, then:

- the contents entries below are still left-aligned, and
- resting the pointer on a tab shows its folder path left-aligned in the card.

## A first section

Text with *emphasis*, **bold**, `code` and a [link](#a-third-section).

## A second section with a longer heading that wraps in a narrow panel

> A quote, so the page has more than headings.

### A nested heading

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `?` | Help |
| `Tab` | Contents |

## A third section

```text
Help's own title and footer stay centred.
```
